precommitted_interpretation_checks: Q3 minus Q2 revenue is +570 USD million and net income is +17 USD million. Billed business rises +4.7 USD billion; do not add it to the income-statement dollar lines.

Diluted EPS rises +0.06 USD per share while average diluted common shares fall 6 million. This does not itself attribute the EPS movement to buybacks because participating-share awards and preferred dividends also enter the EPS calculation.
The principal-only net write-off rate moves from 2.0% to 1.9%, a -0.1 percentage-point change. This ratio does not prove absolute net write-off dollars fell without comparable denominator data.
Q2 and Q3 headline growth percentages compare each quarter to its own prior-year quarter; the event experiment compares Q3 2025 with Q2 2025. Keep these comparison axes separate.
The Q3 release raises full-year guidance, but the selected fact rows do not supply a causal bridge or a valuation/trading conclusion.
